description: This file defines the ProductPagingSource class, which extends PagingSource to load pages of Product objects from a repository. It manages pagination logic, including determining next and previous page keys, handling errors, and providing a refresh key based on the current state.

classes.name: ProductPagingSource
classes.description: A PagingSource implementation for loading pages of Product data based on provided filters and search query.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a page of Product items asynchronously, handling pagination and errors.

methods.name: getRefreshKey
methods.description: Provides a key for refreshing the data based on the current scroll position in the PagingState.
